summary: Concurrent USD/EUR purchases, per-product pricing currencies, local aliases and independent machinery compatibility.
highlights: Enable USD and EUR together and choose a currency when entering a purchase invoice.
Each product keeps its own pricing currency; purchases convert into it while preserving invoice amounts.
Mixed-currency sales and stock valuation use the correct product rates and frozen costs.
Local alias fields make parts and machines searchable by familiar names.
Independent machinery hub and browser follow manufacturer/model category branches, including repair services.
Shared vehicle and machinery components, enhancement-aware ribbons/sidebar and corrected optional vehicle criteria.
Compact working-rate cards include manual, market and central-bank fallback rates.
